_note: Onboarding example. `date` is on every item on purpose: it is never rendered (the visible wording is `meta`/`subtitle`), but it is what lets render-week check that each item really falls inside the week its header announces. A batch where no item is dated is refused rather than rendered — that was the state a real carousel shipped in, with one week's events under another week's title. Render this with `--date 2026-07-31` (any day of the Mon 27 Jul - Sun 2 Aug 2026 week).
_note_hosts: No `sourceImageHosts` here because these slides carry no images. A batch with images copied from a source should declare the hosts they may come from — see system/config/brand.schema.md.
